source_system: Benchmark scans of 10 cloud servers; manual review of the 6 MES and DNC servers
what_it_shows: The 10 scanned cloud servers are 96% compliant with the benchmark settings; no configuration settings are established for the 6 MES and DNC servers, which are not hardened, and drift on shop-floor servers is not monitored

title: Control assessment: least functionality
source_system: Port scan of the Plant 2 network after the last shift (2026-08-13); allowlisting report
what_it_shows: The Plant 2 MES server exposes remote desktop and an outdated file-sharing protocol to the whole plant network, and remote desktop use is not restricted at Plant 2; allowlisting runs in the cloud and at Plant 1

title: Control assessment: system component inventory
source_system: Asset inventory; Plant 2 OT spreadsheet; physical count of 8 cells and the additive area
what_it_shows: The Plant 2 OT spreadsheet (2024) missed 2 additive printer controllers and the vision cell PC; the AI-003 gateway was not in the inventory; the inventory was not updated after the acquisition

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: 2024 cloud disaster recovery procedure; BIA (P05); IT Director interview
what_it_shows: The 2024 procedure covers the cloud landing zone; no contingency plan covers the plants or the MES and DNC

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: PLM restore test record 2025-04; IT Director and Manufacturing Systems Manager interviews
what_it_shows: The 2025-04 PLM test results were reviewed and corrective actions taken; no test in the last 12 months; the MES restore has never been tested at either plant; no effectiveness criteria for shop-floor recovery

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports for July 2026; Plant 2 backup device review
what_it_shows: Backups succeeded on 31 of 31 July days for cloud workloads and the Plant 1 MES and DNC; the Plant 2 MES and DNC back up weekly, unencrypted, to a local device in the same room as the servers

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: IdP policy; sign-in tests at 4 MES terminals (2 per plant)
what_it_shows: Plant 1 terminals required a named badge plus PIN; Plant 2 terminals signed in with shared accounts

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: Sign-in test to 2 MES servers as local administrator
what_it_shows: Local administrator access to the MES and DNC servers at both plants uses a password only

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: IdP password policy; Plant 2 DNC configuration review (2026-08-12); default credential test on 12 OT devices with the Manufacturing Systems Manager
what_it_shows: IdP password settings as configured; 10 of 12 tested OT devices rejected vendor default passwords and 2 additive printer operator panels accepted them; the Plant 2 DNC service credential is stored in plain text in a configuration file; shared Plant 2 MES passwords were not changed when members left

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Incident response plan; 10 of 14 incidents from the last 12 months; MSSP playbooks; 2025 tabletop report
what_it_shows: The 10 sampled cloud and endpoint incidents went through preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication and recovery steps; no detection or analysis capability for shop-floor incidents; recovery steps for MES, DNC and OT, including imaging before rebuild, are not defined; Plant 2 incidents are handled locally; no contingency plan exists to coordinate with

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: Interviews with 15 staff; certificate records; incident log
what_it_shows: 14 of 15 interviewed staff knew how to report an incident; DoD reporting through DIBNet has not been exercised since 2024

title: Control assessment: nonlocal maintenance
source_system: Broker session logs (machine tool vendors); additive printer vendor remote tool; maintenance records
what_it_shows: Machine tool vendor sessions run through the broker with MFA and recording; additive printer vendor sessions use the vendor's own tool with no company strong authentication, monitoring or session records, and the connection stays up after sessions end; the tool was not documented in the SSP at fieldwork

title: Control assessment: media sanitization
source_system: Walkthrough of 8 cells (3 Plant 1, 5 Plant 2) on 2026-08-12; destruction certificates; sanitization records
what_it_shows: Printed drawings were found in general recycling in 3 of 5 Plant 2 cells, and Plant 2 cells keep drawings in open racks; Plant 1 cells use cabinets and locked shred bins with certificates; digital media sanitization is recorded

title: Control assessment: media use
source_system: Walkthrough of the 8 legacy CNC machines at Plant 2 (2026-08-12)
what_it_shows: USB drives used at the 8 legacy machines are not inventoried or labeled; 5 drives with no identifiable owner were found at the machines

title: Control assessment: physical access
source_system: Badge reports; visitor logs and gate camera review for July 2026 (69 visits: 31 Plant 1, 38 Plant 2); walkthroughs 2026-08-11 to 2026-08-13; key inventory
what_it_shows: Badge-controlled areas at both plants and Plant 1 visitor control match the records; the Plant 2 paper log missed 11 of 38 July visits found on the gate camera; 2 unescorted visitors were seen on the Plant 2 floor; 6 Plant 2 exterior door keys issued by the prior owner are unaccounted for and the locks were not changed; the Plant 2 shop-floor printer stands in an open aisle

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: Sample of 25 of 96 terminations; HR Director interview
what_it_shows: 2 of 25 sampled terminations were disabled 3 and 6 days late; shared Plant 2 credentials known to departed operators were not changed; exit interviews were held and property returned for all 25

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring and scanning
source_system: Scan schedule and reports Q1 and Q2 2026; remediation report (30 findings sampled)
what_it_shows: Cloud workloads and endpoints are scanned and the 30 sampled findings were handled to the standard; MES, DNC and all Plant 2 systems are not scanned, and shop-floor vulnerabilities are not tracked

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: FedRAMP Marketplace record; provider CRM; MSSP contract and service description; vendor review records
what_it_shows: Cloud provider requirements, roles and oversight are documented through the FedRAMP authorization and the CRM; the MSSP has not provided a CRM, so roles with the MSSP are not documented; the additive printer vendor has no security terms

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall rule exports; network diagrams; Plant 2 port scan 2026-08-13; Plant 2 network walk 2026-08-12
what_it_shows: The cloud and Plant 1 boundaries are managed and monitored; the Plant 2 internet edge is not monitored by the SIEM; there is no managed interface between the Plant 2 shop floor and its corporate segment, and traffic between them is not controlled; Plant 2 handheld scanners on the shared-key wireless network reach shop-floor systems

title: Control assessment: cryptographic protection
source_system: Cryptographic module table; appliance configurations for the 4 CUI paths
what_it_shows: Cryptographic uses are identified for all CUI paths; the Plant 2 SD-WAN appliance encrypts in non-FIPS mode

title: Control assessment: protection of information at rest
source_system: Encryption reports; Plant 2 server and backup review
what_it_shows: Cloud storage and endpoints are encrypted; the Plant 2 MES server disks and local backups are not encrypted

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch compliance reports; server inventory; MES vendor release notes
what_it_shows: Cloud workloads and endpoints are patched to the standard; the Plant 2 MES and DNC servers run an operating system past end of support; Plant 1 MES servers are 2 quarters behind on security updates; Plant 2 OT and network appliance firmware updates are not tracked

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: MSSP coverage list; use cases; simulated impossible-travel sign-in; General Counsel monitoring opinion (2025)
what_it_shows: The simulated impossible-travel sign-in was escalated in 18 minutes; monitoring covers cloud, identity, endpoints and the Plant 1 firewalls; shop-floor networks at both plants and MES, DNC and OT use are not monitored; the monitoring level was not changed when Plant 2 began handling CUI

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments and reviews
source_system: Supplier files for all 22 suppliers that receive CUI; SPRS lookups
what_it_shows: 14 of 22 suppliers that receive CUI have no verified SPRS status, and no supply chain risk assessment is recorded for them
